selection: exact minimum-cost 2-robust coverage of construction variants with at least two separating probes; variants with fewer are reported and excluded from the requirement
silent_variants: every variant declares the reference contract

tolerance.candidate_rule: a candidate configuration is approved clean for the tested model, revision, dtype and GPU only if it emits no non-finite value and no full-pool probe flags
tolerance.continuations: compared on the longest prefix shared by the reference and every calibration run
tolerance.formula: tau[probe][feature] = 4 * max over calibration runs of max |observed - reference| + 1e-4 nats
tolerance.numerical_health: non-finite values are a separate failure; reference or calibration failure aborts; never used to widen tolerances
tolerance.unstable_positions: teacher-forced argmax positions that change in any calibration run are ties
